name: aws_vpn_connection
description: Encrypted IPsec VPN tunnel connecting on-premises network to AWS VPC via Virtual Private Gateway or Transit Gateway

customer_gateway_id.name: customer_gateway_id
customer_gateway_id.description: ID of the customer gateway (forces new resource)

type.name: type
type.description: Type of VPN connection (currently only ipsec.1)

vpn_gateway_id.name: vpn_gateway_id
vpn_gateway_id.description: ID of the Virtual Private Gateway (conflicts with transit_gateway_id)

transit_gateway_id.name: transit_gateway_id
transit_gateway_id.description: ID of the EC2 Transit Gateway (conflicts with vpn_gateway_id)

static_routes_only.name: static_routes_only
static_routes_only.description: Use static routes only (required for devices that do not support BGP)

enable_acceleration.name: enable_acceleration
enable_acceleration.description: Enable accelerated VPN connection (Transit Gateway only, forces new resource)

local_ipv4_network_cidr.name: local_ipv4_network_cidr
local_ipv4_network_cidr.description: IPv4 CIDR on the customer gateway (on-premises) side

remote_ipv4_network_cidr.name: remote_ipv4_network_cidr
remote_ipv4_network_cidr.description: IPv4 CIDR on the AWS side

tunnel1_inside_cidr.name: tunnel1_inside_cidr
tunnel1_inside_cidr.description: CIDR block for inside IP addresses of tunnel 1 (/30 from 169.254.0.0/16)

tunnel2_inside_cidr.name: tunnel2_inside_cidr
tunnel2_inside_cidr.description: CIDR block for inside IP addresses of tunnel 2 (/30 from 169.254.0.0/16)

tunnel1_preshared_key.name: tunnel1_preshared_key
tunnel1_preshared_key.description: Pre-shared key for tunnel 1 authentication (8-64 chars)

tunnel2_preshared_key.name: tunnel2_preshared_key
tunnel2_preshared_key.description: Pre-shared key for tunnel 2 authentication (8-64 chars)

tunnel1_startup_action.name: tunnel1_startup_action
tunnel1_startup_action.description: Action to take when establishing tunnel 1

tunnel2_startup_action.name: tunnel2_startup_action
tunnel2_startup_action.description: Action to take when establishing tunnel 2

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the VPN connection
